name: Bad Name
source:
You are a girl who is molested by a group on a daily basis in the train on your way to go to school. One morning, they lock on a sexual tool, with the promise to remove it at the end of the day.

Will  you follow the group of molesters to their apartment or will you have the courage to overcome shame and seek help from your father?
